title: Restore app behavior to Draft Version 8

requirements.text: Restore the application code and deployed draft behavior to match the previously working Draft Version 8 build/logic across both frontend and backend (i.e., roll back any changes introduced after Version 8 that altered runtime behavior).
acceptanceCriteria: After rebuild and deploy, the app’s UI flows and data/authorization behavior match the Draft Version 8 behavior as the user experienced it.
No new regressions are introduced in sign-in/sign-out flow, records CRUD (admin + personal), and admin gating versus the Version 8 baseline.
The deployed draft can be opened and used without runtime errors in the browser console.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if state upgrade is necessary.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths; compose those components instead.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product features beyond restoring Version 8 behavior.
Changing the technology stack or adding external services/integrations.
